episodes.title: 7 Years in a Cult: Mind Control, Coercion & Free Will. Guest: Star Spider
episodes.description: Star Spider is the Founder and Executive Director of Counter—a Canadian non-profit dedicated to helping individuals and families recognize, resist, and recover from coercive influence. In this episode award-winning Host of Awakened Souls Podcast Author Jenney Clark sits down with Star to talk about Star 's background in philosophy and seven years of lived experience within a high-control group. Star dismantles the dangerous myth that manipulation only happens to gullible or naive people. This conversation explores how coercive control relies on ordinary human psychology, how subtle conditioning erodes autonomy over time, and what it truly takes to rebuild identity and self-sovereignty after leaving. In this episode, we explore: Ordinary Vulnerability: Why manipulation targets fundamental human social needs rather than intellect or gullibility. The Architecture of Control: How coercive influence operates gradually and relationally from the inside out. Autonomy & Free Will: Philosophical perspectives on agency, belief, and loss of self. Effective Support: How to maintain connection with a loved one in a high-control group without provoking defensive retreat.
